title: 10-Year Treasury Note auction (November refunding new issue) — the last bond session before the Veterans Day closure, and CPI lands the same morning
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream. Row reads verbatim `10-Year NOTE / Wednesday, November 04, 2026 / Tuesday, November 10, 2026 / Monday, November 16, 2026` — no trailing `R`, so a NEW ISSUE, announced by the 2026-11-04 quarterly refunding statement. 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: DISCOVERED during the treasury-30y-bond-2026-11-12 never-assessed initial research (2026-09-08), sweeping that event's +/-5-day corridor. THIS PROPOSAL KNOWINGLY REVISITS A PRIOR DECLINE, on the record: the treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-12 lane saw this row in the same PDF on the same day and deliberately did not file it, because the 11-04 refunding is its natural sizing owner. That is right about sizing and silent about tracking — and the calendar already carries treasury-10y-note-2026-09-09 and treasury-10y-note-2026-10-07 as first-class medium-impact entries under exactly the same owner, so November's leg is missing from a series that is otherwise complete. EXPECTED SIZE, per the grid rather than any current document: $42B — every nominal 10-Year new issue since 2025-02-12 has printed $42B (2025-02, 2025-05, 2025-08, 2025-11, 2026-02, 2026-05, 2026-08; fiscaldata auctions_query pulled 2026-09-08, zero deviations); published 2026-11-04. WHY THIS LEG EARNS ITS OWN SLOT RATHER THAN RIDING THE REFUNDING'S: it is the single densest session in the corridor and the only free read on the block's demand before the 30-Year. Three things land in it — the October CPI print (tracked as cpi-2026-11-10, high impact), the US-China tariff truce expiry (us-china-tariff-truce-expiry-2026-11-10, high impact), and this auction at 1:00pm ET — and it is the LAST bond session before the market shuts for Veterans Day on 11-11, so its close is the reference the 11-12 30-Year auction is measured against with no intervening cash session. Proposed as an estimate; symbols: [] and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry.
